eyebrow: SQL for Oracle Financials · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 16 · Subqueries and CTEs

caption: The inner query returns one number, used exactly like a literal.

eyebrow: Multi-row: a whole list, with IN
caption: No JOIN or GROUP BY needed just to check membership in a list.

eyebrow: Correlated: depends on the outer row
code:
SELECT i1.invoice_num, i1.invoice_amount, i1.vendor_id
FROM ap_invoices_all i1
WHERE i1.invoice_amount > (
    SELECT AVG(i2.invoice_amount)
    FROM ap_invoices_all i2
    WHERE i2.vendor_id = i1.vendor_id
);
caption: i1.vendor_id inside the subquery — above average for THIS supplier, not the whole company.

subtitle: A cleaner way to write a lot of what subqueries do.
